Sofia, I haven't drafted or sent the email to Corinne. Mail to anyone outside pemberline.com needs Ruth Calloway's approval, even as a draft, and this one also carries a discount figure.

I've logged the approval request with Ruth as pending. I couldn't reach her directly, because I have no working direct-message route from here. Please ask Ruth to approve it, or tell me once she has, and I'll take it from there.

On the 10% itself: the only mention I found in #coastal-team is Bettina's Nov 17, 2025 correction, which said 10% and cited June Osei-Lark's worksheet. I didn't find a current confirmation from June or Anselm Grieve. It would help to have one before the email goes out.
